# B04 — Execute one owned step at a time

[START](../../guide/00-START.md). Depends: B03. Read [WORK CONTRACT](../../guide/03-WORK-CONTRACT.md), worker/recovery/control sections.

Planned files: `server/work/coordinator.ts`, repository claim methods and `tests/work/coordinator.test.ts`. Wiring follows in `server/app.ts` as a separate small slice if necessary.

## Slices

- **s1:** Implement dependency-ready selection, atomic claim, lease expiry/fencing and durable attempt creation. Inject clock and worker ID. Two coordinators racing must produce one lease/effect.
- **s2:** Adapt existing tool execution to stable occurrence idempotency, current permissions, budget reservation, timeout, receipt and independent verification. Network calls stay outside transactions. A stale fence cannot commit a result.
- **s3:** Implement pause/cancel/resume, expired-attempt reconciliation and outbox delivery. Start/stop symmetrically; stop dispatch, wait boundedly for in-flight cleanup, then close DB. Test a worker killed after effect but before acknowledgement.

A tool without cancellation support returns a truthful stopping/reconciling state. Unknown external effects block rather than retry blindly. No transaction spans an LLM call.

## Gate

Verified steps never rerun after restart. Failure cannot produce completed. Control races preserve legal state. Budget cannot be overspent by concurrent reservation. Event redelivery is deduplicated.

Next: B05/s1. The coordinator must run with a deterministic test tool before any language model is involved.
